jobs.occupation: Office Manager & Team Assistance (m/f/d) (Office-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

At TYTAN, every mission starts with a first impression, and that's where you come in. As our Office Manager and Team Assistant you are the face and the heartbeat of our Berlin representation. You'll be the first point of contact for guests and partners. You will shape the daily rhythm of the office, create a welcoming environment for our international team, and ensure that everything runs smoothly behind the scenes, including day-to-day support for the team and leadership.
As a young, fast-growing scale-up, we need someone who's comfortable wearing many hats and moving fluidly between office management, team support, and personal assistance to our team lead, depending on what the day brings.

Your roadmap to make an impact:

- Be the ambassador of TYTAN: warmly welcome visitors, partners, and new hires, ensuring they feel the unique spirit of our company from the moment they arrive.
- Keep operations flowing: oversee office organization, supplies, vendor coordination, and facility management to ensure a smooth daily workflow.
- Support leadership and teams: assist with scheduling, travel arrangements, and meeting coordination.
- Provide personal assistance to the team lead and keep the team running: manage calendars, coordinate travel, prepare meetings, and handle recurring personal and organizational matters with discretion.
- Create a vibrant workplace culture: organize events, foster a positive office atmosphere, and help maintain a space where collaboration thrives.
- Be the connector: act as the go-to person for day-to-day questions, guiding colleagues and visitors through processes with clarity and care.

Job requirements

- You bring experience in office management, administration, or a PA role.
- You are a people person: approachable, professional, and always ready to support colleagues and guests with a smile.
- You have excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with an eye for detail, and you enjoy taking ownership of organizational tasks.
- You are fluent in German and English, both spoken and written.
- You thrive in dynamic, young teams and enjoy wearing multiple hats.
- Experience with office tools (MS Office, HR/admin systems).

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

What to Expect

Please submit your CV in English in order to be considered for the role.This role is available in Manchester, Amsterdam, and Berlin.This is a 12-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension.The Installer Support team serves as an escalation point for our network of channel partners who distribute, install and service residential Tesla energy products. - Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Team Lead for Function Controlling (f/m/d) within the SE FIN GS BC SO organisation, you will be at the forefront of acting as business partner for SE GS Solution Functions. Your role will involve driving financial performance and supporting strategic decision-making across the Solution organization of SE GS. Your primary focus will be on optimizing cost controlling processes by implementing AI and Dash solutions, ensuring effective budget planning, and providing insightful analysis of forecasts and actuals. You will lead a global team, coaching and developing team members to achieve their full potential.
Each day, your leadership will strengthen financial performance and enhance accountability across all functions of Solution business.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the financial performance management of cost centres by preparing, consolidating, and analysing forecasts, budgets, and monthly closings
* Act as a business partner by conducting reasonable analyses of key financial drivers for cost centres, delivering clear financial reports that include deviation analyses and actionable performance insights
* Implement and oversee standardized processes and automation initiatives, leverage AI where applicable to streamline operations.
* Develop and implement dashboards that provide real-time insights into cost centre performance and manpower utilization
* Collaborate with various functions to address complex setup topics, accounting questions, and reporting issues, ensuring reliable financial steering and alignment with organizational goals

What You Bring

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
* Extensive experience in financial controlling, FP&A, budgeting, and corporate finance within a complex business environment
* Proven leadership capabilities in developing and managing teams of experienced finance professionals
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive business decisions
* Excellent knowledge of SAP applications, financial reporting, internal controls, and process improvement within a global matrix organization
* Fluent English communication skills; German is beneficial for collaboration within the local business environment 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to serve as the subject matter expert in construction cost estimating across Tesla's EMEA portfolio, including Service Centers, Retail Stores, Delivery Hubs, and Non-SSD sites (R&D, Training, Offices, etc.) You will drive the transition from decentralized regional estimating to a centralized EMEA-wide approach — defining the methodology, standards, templates, and governance for how projects are evaluated. You will deliver independent, reliable construction cost estimates at every project stage, giving project teams, designers, procurement, and leadership a trusted reference for go/no-go decisions.

- Develop cost estimates from Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) through detailed CapEx budgets, with accuracy appropriate to each project stage (AACE estimate classes as reference framework)

- Develop and manage a Basis of Estimate for each project — scope, execution strategy, precision level, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and critical information
- Lead value engineering at early design stages, providing cost-driven feedback and recommendations to designers
- Visit project sites as required to validate scope, site conditions, and constraints in support of estimation — working from assumptions and scope definition provided by the Project Manager, Real Estate team and design team
- Support the Procurement and PMs with contractor pricing validation and bid leveling to ensure we are receiving good value for spends
- Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating processes
- Maintain and update the cost database, ensuring pricing reflects current market conditions, inflation, transport costs, and regional differentiation
- Deliver accurate, independently validated estimates to support ATP and go/no-go decisions; review outputs against historic pricing and regional benchmarks
- Provide expert input to Procurement on sourcing and pricing for atypical works or high cost-variance items

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related field — or equivalent professional experience
- 5+ years as a senior specialist or SME in project cost estimating, preferably in retail, commercial, industrial, or multi-site infrastructure rollout environments
- Practical knowledge of construction means and methods across civil, structural, architectural, MEP disciplines with the ability to translate technical knowledge into accurate, defensible cost advice
- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation
- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level
- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage

jobs.description:
Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Electrical Drive & Controls Engineer, you'll help bring our solar thermal technology to life by developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining the electrical drive and control systems behind our innovative collector technology.

Working alongside Mechanical, Structural and Software Engineers, you'll play a hands-on role in building prototypes, developing test benches, integrating electrical hardware with control software, and validating new solutions before they are deployed in industrial-scale projects.

Your Impact

The systems you build and test will directly improve the reliability, performance, and efficiency of GlassPoint's solar thermal technology.

By combining practical engineering with close collaboration across disciplines, you'll help ensure our innovations perform reliably in the laboratory, during testing, and ultimately in the field.

What You'll Do

Build & Integrate Electrical Systems

- Support the development and integration of electrical drive systems for our solar thermal technology.
- Install, wire, commission, and maintain electrical and control components for prototypes and engineering test benches.
- Troubleshoot electrical systems and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Support Controls & Software Development

- Work closely with software and controls engineers to develop and validate drive and control systems.
- Integrate electrical hardware with control software for prototypes and test benches.
- Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of drive and control systems during testing.
- Assist with functional testing and validation to ensure reliable system performance.

Develop and Maintain Test Systems

- Design, build, install, and maintain electrical systems for engineering test benches supporting the development and validation of our solar thermal components and subsystems.
- Prepare and execute functional testing of electrical drives, control systems, and other electromechanical components.
- Analyse test results and recommend improvements to system performance and reliability.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve technical challenges.
- Support prototype assembly, commissioning, and field testing where required.
- Contribute to technical documentation, engineering standards, and continuous product improvement.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys getting hands-on with hardware and solving practical engineering challenges. You like building, wiring, testing, troubleshooting, and continuously improving electrical systems, and you're comfortable working both in the workshop and alongside multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
- 5+ years of experience developing, integrating, and testing electrical drive and control systems in an industrial environment.
- Hands-on experience wiring, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validating electrical equipment and test systems.
- Experience integrating electrical hardware with control software; experience developing or modifying basic control software is an advantage.
- Experience with PLCs, servo drives, motion control systems, or industrial automation.
- The ability to read electrical schematics and technical drawings.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a practical, structured approach.
- Fluency in English; German is an advantage.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to suppliers and project sites.

What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Meaningful responsibility from day one and the opportunity to make a real impact.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex engineering challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- A highly collaborative environment where your work moves quickly from concept to real-world application.
- Opportunities to grow your technical expertise through cross-functional projects and international collaboration.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.

At GlassPoint, we believe that different perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our teams. We are committed to providing an inclusive working environment where everyone is treated with respect, feels valued, and has the opportunity to contribute their best work.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, ethnic or social background, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.
